install_steps: Install as a kubectl plugin: kubectl krew install sniff (binary lands as kubectl-sniff on PATH)
Or download kubectl-sniff from https://github.com/eldadru/ksniff/releases and move it to PATH
note: Invoked either as 'kubectl sniff' via krew or directly as kubectl-sniff. It uploads a static tcpdump into the pod and streams the capture back — pipe straight into Wireshark or save with -o capture.pcap.
